name: okf-knowledge-base-scriptless
description: Agent-driven knowledge base on the Open Knowledge Format, run as a Karpathy-style LLM wiki — a scriptless variant of okf-knowledge-base. The skills perform initialize/ingest/search/lint directly with built-in file tools (Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Edit); no helper scripts and no Python dependency. Includes a knowledge-curator agent with an end-of-turn capture sweep and a SessionStart hook that detects a KB in the working directory. Install this OR okf-knowledge-base, not both (they share skill names).
